request.subject: CITY:3

layers.text: Repaint the orange-brown roofs and tower cones as clear terracotta red, and the yellow stone of the walls, towers, keep and church as pale warm sandstone, a light cream-beige with slightly darker beige shading. Keep every shape, the walls, the towers, the keep, the church, the houses, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the walls.
